chosen_reason: amendment-3: the raw-DFR comparison cannot handle zero-failure candidates (0 evaluates closer to 1e-3 than 0.135), so the literal rule selected t=150. The scan nevertheless brackets the band (DFR(170) <= 2.5e-3, DFR(180) = 0.135), and the bisection locates t*=172 with C0 DFR 1.67e-3.
waterfall_profile: At BIKE-L1 code parameters the static-classic carrier goes from zero failures at t=170 to 99.9% at t=195 (a 15% window in t), with the 1e-3 band at t*=172 (28% above the production error weight t=134). This sharpness is itself a finding about the production code and is reported as such.
